About this Class

Lane swim is set up in 25m lengths for continuous swimming. This program is open for fitness swimming to anyone 10 years of age and older. Participants between the ages of 6 and 9 must complete the facility swim test for each specific location. Private lessons may only be taught by City of Markham staff during designated lesson times.
